Images.Prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity game UI design presentation, NOT a screenshot of working software. Create one very polished wide landscape 4K-style board for the original Chinese fantasy game SSLM, arranged as FOUR LARGE UI DESIGNS in an evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid. Main title "SSLM · 组队交互". Each design must occupy its own clean spacious quadrant with large legible Simplified Chinese typography, genuine usable control hierarchy, crisp edges and roomy padding. Typography is warm ivory-white Chinese sans-serif with restrained elegant headings.
Art direction: AAA cinematic-quality UI rendering, naturally emerald polished translucent jade frames, slender flowing gold botanical outlines and subtle leaves/vines, dark deep-green glass-like interiors, broad soft continuous highlights. Smooth pure refined surfaces, low visual texture density, readable contrast. NO grit, no sand, no scratches, no weathering, no noise, no jagged high frequency detail, no over-sharpening. Not Blizzard assets or logos; borrow only familiar MMORPG information hierarchy.
Background: uniform nearly-black emerald presentation background with a very faint soft-focus misty fantasy village barely visible, letting the interfaces dominate.
Quadrant upper-left: a full ordinary party management window headed "我的小队", subtitle "3 / 5 名成员". Exactly three filled member rows with attractive original animal-hero circular portraits: "云岚" leader crown, "听雨", "长风"; and two empty invitation slots. Green readiness ticks on two members, one muted "未准备". Buttons "邀请玩家", "准备确认", "离开小队". A small unobtrusive contextual menu beside one row with options "设为队长", "移出小队", "取消". Visually distinguish leader-only management actions.
Quadrant upper-right: an inviting modal headed "组队邀请", inviter original portrait and text "云岚 邀请你加入小队", a concise "当前成员 3 / 5", a smooth thin countdown arc labelled "剩余 60 秒", clear primary jade-gold button "接受邀请" and secondary dark jade button "拒绝". Avoid giant decorative jewels.
Quadrant lower-left: application inbox window headed "入队申请", three tidy applicant rows with name, original small portrait, tiny online dot, and paired compact action buttons "同意" and "拒绝". Names "星河", "青竹", "明月". Small helper line "申请不占用队伍名额". Header tab labels "我的小队" and "申请列表". One selected row highlighted with soft clean jade inset.
Quadrant lower-right: selected-player contextual panel headed "玩家交互", portrait and name "听雨", clear menu rows "邀请组队", "申请加入", "查看角色", and a tasteful disabled-row example "正在匹配，暂不可操作" in restrained gray with a lock icon. Include one small standalone notification chip "邀请已发送" below this panel.
Make all four windows feel part of the same coherent mature design system: consistent corner treatments, 9-slice-ready boundaries, identical button heights and rounded rectangular interaction zones. Keep text short and EXACTLY the specified readable Chinese; no random English strings, no item shop, no factions, no elemental affinities, no fake ratings, no ability-stat numbers, no watermark. This board is a concept reference, not exported UI texture atlas.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: original SSLM game interface concept board; visual reference only, not working-game evidence.
Create a polished high fidelity wide landscape board with FOUR generously spaced designs in a balanced 2 x 2 grid. Only title at top "SSLM · 竞技匹配"; small corner label "界面设计示意". No taglines or extra calligraphy.
Style must be a coherent AAA fantasy game UI system: smooth translucent polished natural emerald jade, deeply dark jade-green inset panels, thin flowing antique-gold botanical lines with very sparse leaves, warm ivory readable simplified Chinese sans-serif type, soft broad continuous highlights, immaculate glossy refined surface. NO grains, grit, sand, noisy microtexture, weathering, scratches or sharpened edges. Original art, no Blizzard icons or logo.
Top-left quadrant: "竞技场" mode selection window. Exactly five equally sized mode buttons "1v1", "2v2", "3v3", "4v4", "5v5"; highlight "3v3". Tabs "练习赛" selected, "规则说明". Information rows "单局歼灭", "小队不可拆分", "允许单人报名". Party entry "我的小队 3 / 5"; selected mode information "每队 3 人". Strong primary button "开始匹配". No rated queue, rankings, seasons, class-role quotas or rewards.
Top-right quadrant: "正在匹配" compact window, selected mode "3v3 · 练习赛", tasteful thin luminous ring not a busy spinner illustration, large elapsed clock "已等待 01:24". One muted row "正在为小队寻找对手", main secondary button "取消匹配". A slim small persistent queue status chip below for HUD use. Never show a fake estimated queue time.
Bottom-left quadrant: invitation-like "找到比赛" ready modal with two clear small teams of three simple player silhouette slots, green accepted dots and one pending neutral dot; large clean circular countdown "30 秒". Main button "接受", secondary "拒绝". Footer "全员确认后进入竞技场". Do not show hidden rating or detailed enemy build. Clear clickable shapes and no clutter.
Bottom-right quadrant: a miniature but legible 16:9 ARENA HUD composition with a very subdued misty jade-stone arena background. Exactly three allied compact frames on left and three enemy frames on right; each contains portrait, white player name placeholder, clean health bar, resource bar, two small buff icons with remaining time. Friendly party label "我方", enemy label "对方". Center top "3v3" and timer "02:18". Near center bottom show a small cast progress bar "正在施法" and a small ability bar; one allied frame shows a muted skull and "已淘汰" rather than respawn countdown. Small hint "死亡后本局不再复活". The HUD must stay legible with roomy screen center and avoid giant ornamental panels.
All four designs share exactly consistent button geometry, 9-slice-friendly panel edges, text size hierarchy and focus outlines. Keep Chinese text accurate and short; no random English paragraphs, fake ratings, faction badges, elemental affinities, shop elements, dense numbers or watermark.

Visual language: natural emerald smooth polished translucent jade panels, slender flowing gold leaf/vine borders, deep jade-green glass-like interiors, ivory readable Chinese sans-serif, broad soft continuous highlights; pure and clean, no grain, grit, noisy texture, scratches, over-sharpening, or Blizzard assets. LEFT: party ready check modal headed "小队准备确认", short line "即将参加 3v3 练习赛", exactly three rows with circular original animal-hero portraits, names "云岚", "听雨", "长风"; first two green checks "已准备", third "等待确认". One slim clock ring "20 秒". Large primary "我已准备", secondary "暂不参加". Small clear helper "名单变更后需要重新确认". A small detached notification chip underneath says "网络未恢复，暂不可操作" with a neutral connection icon, as an explicit unavailable-state design sample, not a fourth party member.
RIGHT: post-match results panel headed "本场结束", tasteful restrained original leaf-crown emblem with text "我方获胜" and subtitle "3v3 · 单局歼灭". A separate small detached error-state notification sample below panel says "返回失败，可安全重试" and a compact "重试" button.
Make clickable shapes clear, every control logically aligned, both windows share identical typography and button geometry. No extra slogans, no huge jewelry, no random English text, no watermark. High legibility at full size.
